query: What award did the creator of the Transformer architecture win?
ground_truth_answer: Vaswani and colleagues received the IEEE Milestone and Test of Time recognition.

corpus.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced in 2017 in the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' co-authored by Ashish Vaswani and Noam Shazeer.
Ashish Vaswani and team won the prestigious NeurIPS Test of Time award and IEEE recognition for revolutionary neural attention mechanisms.
The ResNet architecture was proposed by Kaiming He in 2015 for deep residual learning in computer vision.

query: Which quantization technique uses mixed FP4 and INT8 for modern LLM deployment?
ground_truth_answer: AWQ and bitsandbytes provide mixed precision quantization.

corpus.text: Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and modern FP4 microscaling allow high efficiency LLM inference with minimal perplexity degradation.
